theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury combined with Archetype 4: Editorial High-Contrast
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Cinematic, expensive, moody, avant-garde, stark contrast, high-fashion editorial.

rules.anti_default: Avoid Inter, Roboto, Open Sans. Use tight letter spacing for headings.
rules.hierarchy: H1 max text-6xl, H2 text-4xl. Strong contrast between Display serif headers and geometric sans body.

headings.usage: Hero sections, project titles, gallery headers.

body.usage: Dashboard data, UI controls, prompts, body text.

rules.tinted_grey: All backgrounds are tinted with a cool midnight blue/slate hue. No pure #000000.
rules.contrast: Text over images MUST have gradient overlays (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use p-8 to p-16 for containers to give fashion imagery room to breathe.

grids.marketing: Tetris Grid (asymmetrical, overlapping) for the landing page.
grids.workspace: Control Room Grid (dense, rigid, panel-based) for the AI Generation Studio.
grids.gallery: Masonry or Bento Grid with 1px border-white/10 between items.

corners.explanation: Sharp edges (0px radius) reinforce the Brutalist/High-Fashion editorial aesthetic.

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-200 rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-xs transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-white/20 hover:border-white/60 rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-xs transition-colors

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 hover:border-white/50 focus:border-white rounded-none px-0 py-2 text-white placeholder:text-white/30 transition-colors focus:ring-0 focus:outline-none

cards.style: bg-transparent border border-white/10 group cursor-pointer overflow-hidden
cards.image_treatment: grayscale group-hover:grayscale-0 transition-all duration-700 scale-100 group-hover:scale-105

motion.hover_effects: Images scale up slowly. Borders fade from 10% to 40% opacity. Text transforms slightly.

media.rules: Never use placeholder text or dummy image URLs. Only use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs below.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme and high-contrast editorial aesthetic. Do not use generic SaaS UI templates.
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' or 'Playfair Display' for large, impactful headings. Use 'Outfit' or 'Satoshi' for the dense UI.
Maintain 0px border-radius (sharp corners) on all UI elements (buttons, inputs, cards) for a brutalist high-fashion look.
The Workspace/Studio page must follow the 'Control Room' dense grid, while Galleries/Collections must use 'Bento/Masonry' grids with generous spacing.
Use purely HTML/Tailwind for marketing and gallery sections. Heavily customize Shadcn components for workspace controls, removing default radiuses and shadows.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
DO NOT use placeholder image services. Use ONLY the URLs provided in the media.image_urls array.
